description: This file defines the ViewsOperations class for altering Drupal views queries, specifically for workspace support, including methods for modifying SQL queries, managing table joins, and handling entity revisions within the context of Drupal's workspace module.

classes.name: ViewsOperations
classes.description: A class for altering Drupal views queries to support workspace functionality, including managing table joins and revisions.

methods.name: viewsQueryAlter
methods.description: Implements hook_views_query_alter() to modify views queries based on workspace context.

methods.name: alterQueryForEntityType
methods.description: Modifies the SQL query to handle entity type tables, including adding workspace association tables and revision handling.

methods.name: ensureWorkspaceAssociationTable
methods.description: Ensures the workspace_association table is joined in the query for a specific entity type and relationship.

methods.name: ensureRevisionTable
methods.description: Adds or reuses the revision table join for an entity type within a query.

methods.name: getRevisionTableJoin
methods.description: Creates a join object for the revision table using the workspace_association table.

methods.name: moveEntityTable
methods.description: Reorders the table queue to ensure the workspace_association table appears before a specified alias.
